fields.description: The opaque docname series. Nothing about the volunteer, the certification or the year goes in the primary key.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: Whose certification this is. Identity is read through the volunteer's Red Profile, never copied onto this record.
fields.label: Volunteer

fields.description: Which certification this is, and where its validity period comes from. One row per volunteer per type: a renewal updates the completion and expiry dates on the row that is already there rather than adding a second, so there is never a question of which of two rows is current.
fields.label: Certification Type

fields.description: When the training was completed. The one date a human enters, and the date the whole expiry calculation starts from.
fields.label: Completion Date

fields.description: When this certification stops being valid: the completion date plus the type's configured validity period, recomputed on every save so a society changing the period brings its held certifications with it. Empty when the type never expires. Note what is deliberately absent: there is no lapsed field anywhere on this doctype. Whether a certification has lapsed is derived from this date at the moment of asking by volunteer/services/certification.py::is_lapsed(), so it can never be stale and no scheduled job has to flip it.
fields.label: Expiry Date

fields.description: The course mapping that awarded this certification, when it came from a completed course rather than being recorded by hand. Written by the learning seam, and the reason a repeated completion updates this row instead of creating another. Empty for a certification an administrator entered directly, which is an equally ordinary way to hold one.
fields.label: Awarded By Course Mapping

fields.description: The certificate or serial number the issuing body printed, if there is one. The society's own reference for an external document; nothing in this app reads it.
fields.label: Reference Number

fields.description: Anything about this certification that is not a field: who trained them, what was waived, why the date is what it is.
fields.label: Notes
